goal: Make the cull's burst grouping sub-quadratic without changing a single group.
notes: cull._group now builds exact pigeonhole chunk indexes (whole r8, crop windows r6, zoom windows r6, pan windows grouped by a-side window r5) from 500 frames up and runs each pass's unchanged check only on its own candidates.
